judge_criteria.translation: Equivalent natural Mandarin and preserved intent/relationships; no unmotivated invention.
judge_criteria.voices: Actual speaker attribution, stable role voice instances, intelligibility and appropriate emotion, including offscreen speakers.
judge_criteria.mix: Final Chinese clear, essential music/effects preserved, no intelligible doubled English; compare source sound events. Assess the actual mobile_mix.wav too: Chinese digits, negation, clipped/interrupted speech and essential effects remain audible after mono downmix. Stereo-only success is insufficient.
judge_criteria.subtitle_meaning: Actual Chinese dub, English/Chinese subtitles and burned/soft display are semantically/time consistent.
judge_criteria.continuity: Audit C01-C08 against source AND actual cinema/mobile audio. Verify repeated occurrences independently, self-correction/qualifier scope, interrupted lines, state changes and real speaker instances. Ledger claims earn no credit unless actual outputs support them. No prescribed Chinese wording.

judge_gates.critical_translation: No key negation/relationship/condition/status reversed, no key omitted spoken line.
judge_gates.speaker_assignment: No key role swap or full line on wrong speaker track.
judge_gates.picture_and_voice_timing: No altered picture timeline; visible speech and offscreen event windows usable.
judge_gates.sound_integrity: No double English dialogue, erased essential effects, or inaudible Chinese.
judge_gates.hard_continuity: No omitted/reused occurrence that destroys context; screen text never spoken as character dialogue; no completion/progress/negation/qualifier reversal. Evaluate C01-C08 in actual outputs.
judge_gates.mobile_intelligibility: Actual mobile waveform contains the same complete Mandarin performance; no vanished role, canceling dialogue or erased story-critical effects. If not supplied to Judge, return null rather than assume.
judge_gates.burned_bilingual_subtitles: Both Chinese and English subtitles are actually visible in dub_zh.mp4, consistent with delivered ASS/SRT and source dialogue, confined to bottom 32 percent without hiding essential action. Files alone or unrendered soft subtitles do not satisfy.

task_summary: 将525秒真实连续电影片段制作成普通话译制成片及手机单声道版，解决8组跨场景语义/声源挑战，交付可逐样本审计的角色轨和音乐音效轨。
